title_en: Anti-Secession Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en: Article 1 This Law is formulated in accordance with the Constitution for the purpose of opposing and checking the secession of the country by the "Taiwan independence" secessionist forces, promoting the peaceful reunification of the motherland, maintaining peace and stability in the Taiwan Strait region, preserving state sovereignty and territorial integrity, and safeguarding the fundamental interests of the Chinese nation.

Article 2 There is only one China in the world, and both the mainland and Taiwan are part of China. China's sovereignty and territorial integrity brook no division. Safeguarding state sovereignty and territorial integrity is the common obligation of all Chinese people, including the compatriots in Taiwan.
Taiwan is part of China. The State shall never allow the "Taiwan independence" secessionist forces to secede Taiwan from China under any pretext or by any means.

Article 3 The Taiwan issue is a legacy of the Chinese civil war.
The resolution of the Taiwan issue and the realization of the reunification of the motherland are internal affairs of China, which shall not be subject to interference by any foreign forces.
Article 4 Accomplishing the great cause of the reunification of the motherland is the sacred duty of all Chinese people, including the compatriots in Taiwan.

Article 5 Upholding the One-China principle is the foundation for the peaceful reunification of the motherland.
To reunify the motherland by peaceful means best serves the fundamental interests of the compatriots on both sides of the Taiwan Strait. The State shall do its utmost with the greatest sincerity to achieve peaceful reunification.
After the reunification of the country by peaceful means, Taiwan may practice systems different from those of the mainland and enjoy a high degree of autonomy.

Article 8 If the "Taiwan independence" secessionist forces commit an act of seceding Taiwan from China under any pretext or by any means, or if a major incident that would cause the secession of Taiwan from China occurs, or if the possibility of peaceful reunification is completely lost, the State may take non-peaceful means and other necessary measures to safeguard state sovereignty and territorial integrity.
The decision to take non-peaceful means and other necessary measures as provided for in the preceding paragraph shall be made and implemented by the State Council and the Central Military Commission, and the matter shall be reported to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress without delay.

Article 9 When non-peaceful means and other necessary measures are taken and implemented in accordance with the provisions of this Law, the State shall do its utmost to protect the lives, property, and other legitimate rights and interests of Taiwanese civilians and of foreigners in Taiwan, and to minimize losses. At the same time, the State shall, according to law, protect the rights and interests of the compatriots in Taiwan in other regions of China.
Article 10 This Law shall come into force as of the date of its promulgation.
